sites.title: Lever sites
sites.description: Lever site names or any Lever URL. A site name is the last part of `jobs.lever.co/<site>`. Accepted: `spotify`, `https://jobs.lever.co/zoox`, `https://jobs.eu.lever.co/pnlfin`, and posting or `/apply` URLs (reduced to their site). Invalid entries are reported in the run SUMMARY and skipped.

region.title: Lever region
region.description: Which Lever instance to read. Auto uses the host of a pasted URL; for a plain site name it tries the global instance first and the EU instance when the global one answers 404.
enumTitles: Auto (URL host, else global then EU)

teams.title: Teams (server-side)
teams.description: Exact Lever team names. Sent to Lever, so other postings are never downloaded. Case-insensitive, whole value, several values = OR. Run with 'Discover filters' to list the exact values of a site.
teams.sectionDescription: Applied by Lever itself. Different fields combine with AND, several values inside one field with OR. Use the exact values shown by 'Discover filters'.

departments.title: Departments (server-side)
departments.description: Exact Lever department names (case-insensitive, whole value, OR).

locations.title: Locations (server-side)
locations.description: Exact Lever location names such as `London` or `New York, NY`. Case-sensitive. Matches any of a posting's locations. Several values = OR.

commitments.title: Commitments (server-side)
commitments.description: Exact commitment names such as `Full-time`, `Permanent`, `Contract` (case-insensitive, OR). The wording differs per company.

levels.title: Levels (server-side)
levels.description: Exact level names, for the companies that use them (case-insensitive, OR).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Case-insensitive match on title, team and department. Words separated by spaces must all match; separate alternatives with commas (`data engineer, analyst`).

workplaceTypes.title: Workplace types
workplaceTypes.description: Keep only postings with one of these workplace types. Leave empty for all.

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: Only postings created on or after this moment. A date (`2026-10-01`), an ISO timestamp, or a relative value such as `7 days`, `2 weeks`, `36 hours`, `1 month`.

salaryOnly.title: Only postings with a published salary
salaryOnly.description: Keep only postings where the employer published a salary range.

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: Format of the opening, description, additional and salaryDescription fields. Choose None for the smallest output.

includeLists.title: Include requirement lists
includeLists.description: Add the posting's sections (for example 'What you'll do', 'Who you are') as `lists`: `[{heading, items[]}]` with plain-text items.

discoverFilters.title: Discover filters
discoverFilters.description: Instead of postings, output one record per site with its distinct teams, departments, locations, commitments, levels and workplace types and how many postings each has. Server-side filters still apply; keyword, workplace type, posted-since, salary and incremental options are ignored. One Job result is charged per site record (not per posting), counts against your maximum charge like any record, and a site that fails costs nothing.

onlyNewJobs.title: Only new postings
onlyNewJobs.description: Deliver only postings that earlier runs with the same state key have not delivered. The first run delivers everything. Remembered postings are kept in the named key-value store `lever-job-feed-state` (at most 200,000 per state key, least recently seen dropped first) and forgotten after 90 days off the board. A run stops with an error if another run of the same state key is still running.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Names the remembered set for 'Only new postings'. Use a different key for each distinct schedule or filter setup, and do not run two schedules with the same key at the same time.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of postings in total, newest first, split evenly across sites (a site with fewer postings hands its unused share to the others).
